learnings: An *iterable* returns a fresh iterator from `__iter__`; an *iterator* returns itself and is consumed once.
`iter(callable, sentinel)` and `next(it, default)` remove most manual try/except around iteration.
pitfalls: The first cursor popped items out of the collection's own page lists, so every later loop came back empty – iterators must copy or index, never consume shared data.
